content:
nina: FYI - during our routine audit we discovered multiple OAuth2 client secrets issued to internal apps that are stored as plaintext in an SFTP archive. No signs of compromise, but we must rotate all affected client secrets and migrate clients to OIDC with PKCE or JWT client auth where possible. Target deadline: 2026-04-10 23:59 UTC.

id-bot: Automated discovery: 5 OAuth clients with long-lived client secrets found (authz-server clients: internal-admin, metrics-ui, legacy-api, reporting-worker, docs-sync). Full list and owners recorded in secure ticket RW-Sec-1105.

carlos: Ack. For legacy-api and reporting-worker I can rotate secrets. Do we have a recommended migration path to JWT client auth?

nina: Recommended steps:
1) Rotate client secret and update client config in secret manager.
2) Prefer OIDC with either PKCE (for public/native apps) or JWT client assertion (for server-to-server).
3) Update downstream services to use the new auth flow, add canaries, and revoke old secret after verification.

patrick: I'll take internal-admin and docs-sync. Note: docs-sync runs from an on-prem cron box that only supports client secret flow today. We should prioritize adding JWT client auth support or short-lived proxies.

ops-oncall: Suggest short-term plan: rotate secrets on servers, add ENV flag to read NEW_CLIENT_SECRET, deploy canary, then rotate in secret manager and revoke old secret after 1 hour if canary OK. Schedule maintenance window: 2026-04-09 01:00-03:00 UTC.

security-ops: Commands and examples:
```bash
# rotate secret (example using internal API)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \ 
  https://auth.internal.redwood/v1/clients/legacy-api/rotate-secret -d '{}'
# fetch new secret into secret manager
secretsctl put --name projects/prod/secrets/legacy-api-client --data-file new-secret.txt
```

nina: If your client cannot immediately support JWT assertions, create a short-lived secret (<24h TTL) and schedule migration. We'll also add an org policy to block creation of new long-lived OAuth client secrets without approval.

carlos: owner: legacy-api - action: rotated - old_revoked: yes - notes: updated service, canaries passed.

patrick: owner: docs-sync - action: rotated - old_revoked: no - notes: cron box cannot rotate due to appliance constraints, requesting exception for 7 days and plan to proxy via token-exchange. Filing RW-Sec-EXCEPT-45.

security-ops: Good catch: audit also flagged clients using outdated redirect URIs and some with wildcard URIs. We'll require exact-match redirect URIs for all OAuth clients by 2026-05-01 and disable wildcards.

ops-oncall: Reminder for owners: if you embed client secrets in container images or scripts, rebuild images and clear caches after updating secrets. Some runtimes cache tokens; restart processes.

nina: Please post final status lines when done: `owner: client - action: rotated/migrated - old_revoked: yes/no - notes`. We'll run a re-scan on 2026-04-11 and auto-revoke remaining old secrets.

carlos: owner: reporting-worker - action: migrated - old_revoked: yes - notes: switched to JWT client assertions, CI updated, verified job runs.

patrick: owner: docs-sync - action: exception-requested - old_revoked: no - notes: exception requested, proxy implementation in progress, ETA 2026-04-16.

nina: Thanks all. Follow-up: we'll add a short migration guide to infra docs with samples for PKCE and JWT client assertions and host office hours for Q&A. :lock:
